北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴冷，体感 -2℃，多穿点哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and chilly, feels like -2℃. Dress warmly!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴好，体感 2℃，早晚注意保暖。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny and cool, feels like 2℃. Keep warm in mornings and evenings.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴朗，体感 4℃，出门别忘添衣。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is clear and cool, feels like 4℃. Don't forget an extra layer when you go out.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光好，体感 8℃，出门尽享好天气！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny and mild, feels like 8℃. Enjoy the lovely weather!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，体感 9℃，宜人舒适。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and pleasant, feels like 9℃. Enjoy the comfortable weather.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州晴朗，体感 4℃，昼夜温差大，注意保暖。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is clear and cool, feels like 4℃. Mind the temperature difference and keep warm.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京晴朗，体感 3℃，风微凉，记得加衣哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is clear and cool, feels like 3℃ with a slight breeze. Remember to layer up!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴好，体感 5℃，湿度高，注意防潮哦。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and cool, feels like 5℃. High humidity, so be mindful of dampness.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴冷，体感 2℃，湿度大，记得防寒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is clear and chilly, feels like 2℃ with high humidity. Remember to keep warm.
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 2℃，空气干燥，记得补水。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is clear and cool, feels like 2℃. It's dry, so remember to hydrate.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云，体感 8℃，出门感受舒适天气。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and mild, feels like 8℃. Enjoy the comfortable weather when you go out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -24℃，务必全副武装防寒！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -24℃. Bundle up thoroughly against the cold!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -24℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴冷，体感 -12℃，出门注意防寒保暖。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is clear and very cold, feels like -12℃. Remember to keep warm when you go out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明有雾，体感 4℃，注意交通安全和保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is foggy and cool, feels like 4℃. Drive safely and keep warm.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴好，体感 6℃，风力较大，小心着凉。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is clear and pleasant, feels like 6℃ with stronger winds. Be careful not to catch a cold.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛晴冷，体感 -2℃，风力大，务必多穿！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is clear and cold, feels like -2℃ with strong winds. Be sure to dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -8℃，出门记得做好防寒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and cold, feels like -8℃. Remember to bundle up when you go out.
